_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the UNO score tracker + in-app manual library. The scoring engine and the manual renderer both read this. Point values, flags, and cards were verified against official Mattel instruction sheets (see each variant's sourceUrl), except Liar's UNO (verifiedAgainstMattelPdf:false). Card effects are short summaries; full booklet-style text lives in uno-manual-library.md.
_meta.scoringEngineNote: Default Mode A (winner_takes): only the round winner scores, gaining the summed point value of every opponent's remaining cards; first to `target` wins. Mode B (lowest_total) is the official alternative where each non-winner accrues their own held-card value and the LOWEST total wins when someone hits `target`. Both modes use the same `cards[].points` table.
_meta.cardCategories: NUMBER = face value; ACTION = colored action card; WILD = wild/wild-action card. `points` is authoritative regardless of category.
_meta.handSizeWarning: Do NOT derive hand sizes from card events for variants whose drawRule is draw_until_playable or launcher, or that contain draw-until-color effects (wild_color_roulette, wild_draw_color). Those add a random/unbounded number of cards; track hand size by manual adjustment only.
